<section class="home-section home-about">
  <div class="container about-grid">
    <div class="about-text reveal">
      <span class="eyebrow">About</span>
      <h2 class="section-title">Field data, farm economics and code</h2>
      <p>
        I'm an agricultural economist and a research analyst at Laterite in Addis Ababa.
        My work covers the whole life of a survey: designing the questionnaire and the sample,
        programming it in SurveyCTO, checking data quality while teams are in the field,
        then cleaning and analysing what comes back. The studies cover agriculture, clean energy,
        health, nutrition, education and refugee livelihoods, in Ethiopia and elsewhere in Africa.
      </p>
      <p>
        My own research is about Ethiopian smallholders: how productive they are, whether selling
        more of their harvest changes that, and how households hold up when prices or conflict hit
        the whole economy. Outside work I write R and Stata packages that other researchers use to
        pull, clean and convert survey data.
      </p>

    <div class="card-grid card-grid-3">

          <h3>Smallholder productivity</h3>
          <p>Technical efficiency and input adoption on Ethiopian farms, measured with stochastic frontier models.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="reveal">
        <div class="card-soft interest">
          <span class="interest-icon"><i class="bi bi-shop"></i></span>
          <h3>Crop commercialization</h3>
          <p>Whether farmers who sell more of their cereal harvest are more efficient. My Ghent thesis used instrumental variables to answer it, and I am reworking it into a paper on productivity misallocation.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="reveal">
        <div class="card-soft interest">
          <span class="interest-icon"><i class="bi bi-basket"></i></span>
          <h3>Food insecurity and shocks</h3>
          <p>How exposed urban and rural households are when a shock hits the whole economy. A paper on this is in its second round of review at <em>Scientific Reports</em>.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

<script>
(function () {
  var reduce = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  var items = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal");

  function countUp(el) {
    var target = parseInt(el.getAttribute("data-count"), 10);
    var suffix = el.getAttribute("data-suffix") || "";
    var start = null;
    function step(ts) {
      if (!start) start = ts;
      var p = Math.min((ts - start) / 900, 1);
      el.textContent = Math.round(target * p) + suffix;
      if (p < 1) window.requestAnimationFrame(step);
    }
    window.requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }

  if (reduce || !("IntersectionObserver" in window)) {
    items.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add("is-visible"); });
    return;
  }

  var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
    entries.forEach(function (entry) {
      if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
      entry.target.classList.add("is-visible");
      entry.target.querySelectorAll(".stat-num[data-count]").forEach(countUp);
      io.unobserve(entry.target);
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.15 });

  items.forEach(function (el) { io.observe(el); });
})();
</script>
